about: Request class -> device for 1bit serve --laya (RFC #186, docs/laya.md). A row may name any device the model can run on; a device not available for the model falls back to default. Change a row only with a measured net gain (decode and time to first token, the Laya decision included). Vulkan is leaving the engine (RFC #213): HRX is the GPU route, and the lean ROCm build serves long prompts.

code.why: HRX is the engine's GPU route (RFC #213). Plain decode is within 10% of Vulkan on the four gate models; Qwen3.8-27B 12.15 against 12.48 tok/s (llama.cpp fork #43-#45, 2026-09-29). With --mtp, HRX is still slower than Vulkan was (20.1 against 34.6 tok/s on code): verify batches of 2-4 tokens are the open item.

short.why: Same device as code: a short reply is a few tokens of decode after a short prompt.

long_doc.why: Prompt processing dominates. Qwen3.8-27B UD-Q4_K_XL, llama-bench, 2026-10-01: the lean ROCm build 365-368 tok/s pp512 and 351-354 pp2048, HRX 97-99 for both. ROCm reads any GGUF.
